feedback: Iteration 2's results show that reducing base speed to 1.1 and increasing integral gain to 0.4 improved steady-state control but did not fully prevent stalls or off-track events. The geometry changes moving sensors forward and widening their lateral spread should help early line detection and lateral coverage, supporting these controller settings. If the next race shows continued stalls or line loss events, consider increasing sensor lateral spread further or adjusting sensor y-positions forward within allowed limits. If off-track events persist, consider slightly reducing body length or wheel track to improve turning agility. If progress and completion improve with fewer stalls, maintain current geometry and consider fine-tuning controller gains further.
requested_changes: sensor_positions: increase lateral spread up to ±0.08 m based on iteration 2 evidence of improved line detection with wider spread
sensor_positions: move sensors forward up to y=0.08 m to enhance early line detection, supported by iteration 2 rationale
